project.name: ReativaConquistas
project.productType: SaaS toolbox and browser editor for Minecraft Bedrock worlds
stack: Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript
Cloudflare Worker APIs for payments and entitlements
Local browser processing for world files

instructions: Preserve the existing application and server contracts

design.colorMode: dark, with an explicit light preference
design.typography: System sans-serif; restrained sizes and clear hierarchy
design.shadows: Subtle shadow for overlays; flat work surfaces
design.motion: Short state transitions; respect reduced motion

patterns: Marketing homepage with a single prominent world upload
Editor shell with a desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation
Tool cards with one description, one access note and one action
Compact pricing cards bound to the existing server plan IDs
Dedicated 3D workspace with the existing canvas renderer

must: The Worker remains authoritative for plan, entitlement and payment state
World files stay in browser processing and the original remains unchanged
Keep the existing HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript stack
Keep the 3D renderer isolated to the Builder route
Preserve legacy URLs, DOM IDs, account sessions and checkout handlers
avoid: Invented per-operation credit prices or purchase products
Fake operation history or feature states
Excessive gradients, glow, glass effects and decorative motion
Installing React, Tailwind or a component library for this redesign
Using rarity colors outside their semantic meaning

decisions: Use one calm dark green system with a light option, thin borders and moderate radii.
Keep the homepage focused on selecting a world; enter the editor shell only after the server accepts the file limit.
Separate the existing tools catalog and actual server-backed plans into dedicated pages while retaining the current home and plan anchors.
Display only the existing one-world credit balance and server plan; do not imply a general operation-credit wallet.
Adapt 21st.dev navigation, upload, pricing and empty-state patterns to vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript without importing React dependencies.

evidence.source: 21st.dev upload components and File Upload reference
